Comes with 3 interior upgrades to purchase and four recolor skins to better suit your game.
Pair it with: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35943]Florist Furniture[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36273?tab=posts&BH=0]Outdoor Flowers[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16717]Greenhouse Furniture[/url] 
for all the decoration you could want!﻿﻿﻿
